# LTS Market

> New and used aesthetic equipment. Prices are in PLN.

The site is available in Polish, English and Russian. Canonical HTML pages are the source of truth. Markdown versions preserve their language, specifications, prices and service qualifications. LTS Market is the seller; Laser Tech Service is the service provider named on the pages. Service scope and financing terms must be read from the relevant HTML page, not inferred from another product.

- [PL — Profesjonalne urządzenia dla branży beauty i med](https://ltsmarket.pl/): LTS Market — nowe i używane urządzenia kosmetologiczne i laserowe dla salonów beauty i med. Leasing, serwis, szkolenia i wsparcie techniczne w całej Polsce. [Markdown](https://ltsmarket.pl/index.md)
